summary: 派生artifact(型・API契約・DB schema・validation・テストfixture)を一つの機械可読な仕様(schema/契約)から生成・検証し、人手の重複記述を減らす。

evidence.summary: Anchor: instruction/environment/oracle/verifierが'loosely coupled processes'で作られると'artifact drift'(unsolvable, reward-hackable, internally inconsistent)が生じる。単一parametric specificationからinstruction・環境・ground truth・state-based verifierを同時生成して整合させる。ERP-Bench 300 tasks(benchmark生成文脈)。
'Duplication is Evil'/'Update Docs with Code'。重複は分岐の源。
spec-as-source: 仕様から生成/検証される二次artifactとしてcodeを扱う枠組み。API・enterprise・embeddedの事例。

contract-first (public, reputation established): read skills/contract-first/SKILL.md in the repo: 'Coordinate frontend/backend or service-to-service work through one authoritative, machine-checkable contract ... both sides verify against the same artifact before integration', 'Choose one canonical, version-controlled artifact for each boundary' (OpenAPI / AsyncAPI / Protobuf / JSON Schema), 'Do not maintain the same payload shape independently in a wiki, prose document, mock file, and provider code.'

applies_when: 同じ構造を型・schema・validation・doc・testに手書きしている
Firestore document shape、API入出力、content frontmatterなど契約が複数箇所に現れる
not_applicable_when: 契約が1箇所にしか現れない
生成器の保守費が仕様変更頻度に見合わない

expected_effect.primary: artifact間の整合を構造で保証し、要求変更の伝播漏れ(A07)を型/生成エラーとして検出
metrics: 仕様変更1件あたりの手動更新file数
不整合起因のバグ件数

risks: 生成器・schemaが新たな正本になり保守対象が増える
過剰な自動生成でcodeが読みにくくなる
cost: schema(zod/OpenAPI等)と生成/検証の導入。数日〜
known_failure_modes: Anchorの結果はbenchmark生成での知見であり、一般開発への転移は推論(inference)
仕様の意味レベルの矛盾(A05の業務ルール矛盾)は型では捕まらない。RMD-A01-003を併用
controller_notes: 2026-08-15: renamed from RMD-A05-001 on merge into authority catalog (ID taken by routine research record).

matched_on: consumers and providers verify against the same artifact instead of restating it
prevents field/enum/nullability drift across derived artifacts

alternates.why_not_primary: established 'Contract First - the contract is the spec' guidance, but about designing the interface, not generating/verifying derived artifacts from a machine-readable schema

evidence: SKILL.md read: 'Contract First - define the interface before implementing it. The contract is the spec - implementation follows', Hyrum's Law, validate at boundaries

alternates.why_not_primary: its Plan phase does generate data-model.md and contracts/ from the spec, but as one-shot design artifacts rather than a maintained machine-checkable contract

evidence: https://github.com/github/spec-kit (129,168 stars, last commit 2026-08-14, maintained by the GitHub org)
https://github.com/github/spec-kit/blob/main/templates/commands/clarify.md (Goal: detect and reduce ambiguity in the active feature spec and record clarifications in the spec file)
https://github.com/github/spec-kit/blob/main/templates/commands/plan.md (loads FEATURE_SPEC + memory/constitution.md, resolves NEEDS CLARIFICATION, emits data-model.md and contracts/)

alternates.why_not_primary: verifies both sides against a contract but does not establish it as the generation source; emerging
